en.headline: Transport Department delays ride-hailing vehicle permits to early 2027
en.dek: Driving permit applications open on 30 November with no cap, but vehicle permits limited to 10,000 will not open until early next year, postponing licensed platform operations.
body: The Transport Department said applications for ride-hailing vehicle driving permits will be accepted from 10am on 30 November with no limit on numbers issued and available year-round.

Applicants must be at least 21, hold a Hong Kong identity card without stay conditions, have held a valid full private car or light goods vehicle licence for at least one year, and have no serious traffic convictions in the past five years. They must also have passed the combined written test and completed a pre-service course, though valid taxi licence holders may apply directly.

Vehicle permits, capped at 10,000 under the law, will be invited only in early 2027. If applications exceed the limit, allocation will be by drawing lots, with extra chances for those who have already passed the test or held a driving permit, and for those who owned a private car before 3 August 2026.

The department said the weighting aims to prioritise early preparers and avoid a rush to buy cars that could add pressure on roads. Licensed platforms are therefore not expected to begin operations before the end of 2026.

zh.headline: 運輸署將網約車車輛許可證申請延至明年初
zh.dek: 網約車車輛駕駛許可證下周一接受申請，數量不設上限；但一萬個車輛許可證要到明年初才公開邀請，平台未能如期在年底前營運。
body: 運輸署表示，網約車車輛駕駛許可證將於11月30日上午10時起接受申請，全年開放，數量不設上限，可透過智方便系統網上遞交。
申請人須年滿21歲，持有香港永久性居民身份證或無逗留條件的身份證，持有有效私家車或輕型貨車正式駕駛執照至少一年，過去五年無嚴重交通定罪，並已通過綜合筆試及完成職前課程；持有有效的士駕駛執照者可直接申請。
車輛許可證根據法例上限為一萬個，運輸署計劃明年初才公開邀請申請。若申請超額，將以抽籤分配，已通過筆試或持有駕駛許可證者，以及在2026年8月3日前已擁有私家車者，可獲額外中籤機會。
署方指此安排旨在優先處理提早準備的人士，並避免市民急於購車加重路面負荷。因此，持牌網約車平台未能在2026年底前開始營運。
